records.title: XRPL EscrowFinish protocol rules
records.notes: FinishAfter prevents EscrowFinish before the eligible ledger close; a successful EscrowFinish transaction is required to deliver the funds. Any account may submit it, subject to conditions. Time eligibility is not itself a transfer.

records.title: SBI Ripple Asia conceptual proof of concept for tokenized deposits and deposit-backed digital money on XRPL
records.notes: SBI Ripple Asia described a conceptual PoC using SBI MoneyTap and its token issuance platform, with XRPL as the proposed blockchain. This is a proof of concept, not evidence of a production deposit-token network or live settlement volume. SBI Ripple Asia is a joint venture of SBI Holdings and Ripple.

records.title: ACI Worldwide and Circle collaborate on USDC settlement in Latin America
records.notes: A Colombian pilot uses ACI Connetic and the Bre-B instant-payment infrastructure to demonstrate USDC settlement alongside existing payment rails. ACI describes an evolving multi-rail ecosystem and future settlement models. The announcement does not mention XRP or publish transaction volumes.

records.title: Ripple and Coinbase partner to expand access to RLUSD
records.notes: Ripple announced RLUSD availability across Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and Coinbase Retail, with support across XRPL, Base and Ethereum and 1:1 conversion from USD and other supported USD stablecoins. RLUSD collateral availability for Coinbase Global Exchange customers is described as following later; it is not established as live collateral at announcement.

records.title: Coinbase official blog: RLUSD added to Prime, Exchange and Coinbase app
records.notes: Coinbase's October 28 blog listing confirms RLUSD availability on Coinbase Prime, Coinbase Exchange and the Coinbase app. It corroborates Ripple's announcement; it does not disclose resulting RLUSD balances, trading volume or collateral balances.

records.title: Linux Foundation operational launch of x402 Foundation
records.notes: Coinbase contributed the x402 protocol to a vendor-neutral, Linux Foundation-governed foundation. This is not a Coinbase-exclusive protocol or proof of Coinbase-operated XRPL settlement.

records.title: T54 XRPL x402 facilitator technical documentation
records.notes: Documents payer-signed XRPL Payment transactions, invoice binding, verification and settlement, and support for XRP and issued-token assets including RLUSD and USDC. T54 operates a third-party XRPL facilitator; this is not a Coinbase-owned integration. Documentation does not establish aggregate market volume.

records.title: Independent XRPL x402 payment fingerprint and volume monitor
records.notes: Describes a reproducible scan of validated ledgers using SourceTag 804681468, t54-xrpl-x402 memo and invoice binding. It explicitly says the facilitator's nearly-one-million cumulative claim cannot be independently audited by that page; it reports a lower recent on-chain stream. Its live counter and narrative hourly rate are not fully consistent, so only the fingerprint method is admitted.

records.title: XRPL AI Hub x402 settlement dashboard
records.notes: Dashboard reports approximately 14.77M volume and $45,169.01 all-time value settled, 183 registered merchants and 5,318 live services. If the volume count is transactions, implied average value is about $0.00306 each. The count is not independently reconciled with xrpl.fi's lower reproducible counter; do not treat it as confirmed market-wide activity.
